a: Canvas layers the layer list does not name jump below every listed layer after the first reorder
`RenderContext.trial.setZoom` answers zoom differently from the trial chrome's setZoom: unclamped and about the world origin
The first cross-redo check after a reload drops both histories' saved redo
An instrument history that mounts again while its trial stays open starts empty, and the next save writes that
A config write to an `over` path that ends where it started leaves an empty undo step; a trial path takes it back
b: The trial chrome context is rebuilt on every render, because `view2d` is a fresh object each time
A layer toggle or reorder records an undo step that cannot undo it: layer order and visibility live outside the snapshot
A canvas layer not named in `layers.ids` jumps to the bottom of the stack after the first reorder
An `alwaysOn` layer is drawn hidden when visibility says false, while the list shows it on
The tool slot's chrome memo never holds: `setActiveTool` is a new closure every render
A saved trial history is marked restored before `enabled` is checked, so it is lost if the instrument gains `undo` later
